brief: @buildthis.bisks.net A field to enter my Bluesky handle (with lookup), then it fetches tweets from several of my moots, picks some mid-liked ones, and they get placed on a conspiracy-theory corkboard with yarn randomly connecting the pieces
note: built mootboard — enter a handle, it pulls real posts from your moots, pins the suspiciously medium-liked ones to a corkboard, strings red yarn between them. clicking a card opens the actual post.
